findings.text: FINDING imas_ambix/agent/watch.py:696 follow-on: _endpoints_in_median re-derives the endpoint-selection loop that imas_ambix/agent/provider_prices.py:476-492 (provider_median_in_force) already owns, and reaches the private _declares_fewer_than_eight_bits at watch.py:708 under a noqa: SLF001; the count in the label is a second copy of the median's own filter, so a later change to the owner's precision floor or selection could leave the printed count disagreeing with the median printed beside it. Not blocking: no public count owner exists, section 18 directs the count to be read from the held history, and provider_prices is outside this node's write scope.

FINDING imas_ambix/agent/watch.py:834 follow-on: the unrecorded-segment branch hard-codes policy=PRICE_POLICY_MEDIAN, but the rate chosen at :828 may come from rate_in_force (the headline) or price_at (the table) when provider_median_in_force returns None; price_policy is the machine-readable statement of which price history answered, so a row priced off the headline can still report the median policy.

FINDING imas_ambix/agent/watch.py:752 follow-on: the namespace keeps two label helpers -- the new _cost_label:497 and the existing cost_label:494 it wraps -- which is a readability cost rather than a defect, and a reader now has to open both to see the full label.
